answer: Before first payout, the holder stays one night at a registered glacier haven and signs its velvet-bound guest book, the warden countersigning the entry. Two verifiers match the entry against the haven's register within a week; an entry claimed twice, or a signature matching no warden, closes both. A night at the haven costs 2.5 million rupiah, so one holder pays once while a thousand fakes need a thousand nights and 2.5 billion.
